# Incoterms

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List incoterms

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms`

Retrieve a paginated list of incoterms with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: creator | `creator` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[code]` | string | No | Filter by incoterm code (partial match) |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by incoterm name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Options: with, only |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `code` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms?include=creator&sort=code&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms?include=creator&sort=code&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms?include=creator&sort=code&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',

    ],

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create incoterm

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms`

Create a new incoterm

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `code` | string | Yes | Incoterm code (3 characters). Must not be greater than 3 characters. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Incoterm name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "code": "EXW",
  "name": "Ex Works"
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "code": "EXW",
  "name": "Ex Works"
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/incoterms', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'code' => 'EXW',
    'name' => 'Ex Works',
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
```
